body.name: Finite response-type fiber polytope
body.construction: Enumerate \(\{\mathcal R_x:x\in\mathcal X\}\), assign weights \(\lambda_{xr}\ge0\) for \(r\in\mathcal R_x\), and define \(\Xi(p)\) by unit total mass, \(T_0\lambda=p\), stratum positivity, and always-selected-complier mass at least \(m_*\). Associate each feasible weight vector with the latent law that first draws \(X,R\) with masses \(\lambda_{xr}\), then draws \(Z\) from the known table and applies the declared consistency and exclusion maps.
